name: Przemko II
note: died without heirs; John of Bohemia seized the duchy

name: Henry I of Jawor
note: duchy vassalized by the Kingdom of Bohemia

name: Henry V of Iron
note: one half of Głogów (other half annexed by Bohemia); Duke of Głogów and Żagań

name: Jan I of Żagań
note: jointly with his brothers; Rupert I of Legnica regent 1397–1401

name: Henry XI
note: line extinct, whole duchy directly under the Crown of Bohemia

name: Jan II the Mad
note: of Żagań; northern part sold to Brandenburg 1482

name: John Corvinus
note: as Jan II, Duke of Głogów

name: Sigismund I the Old
note: last duke; in 1506 the duchy became an immediate dominion of the Bohemian Crown
